checks.text: The page shows the heading "Countdown Timer" and the text "No timer set".
Typing "1h 20m" in the field labelled "Duration" and clicking the button "Start" changes the large display to "1:20:00" and shows the buttons "Pause" and "Reset".
After starting a timer with Duration "0m 10s", clicking the button "Pause" stops the countdown and shows the button "Resume" instead of "Pause".
After pausing a running timer, clicking the button "Resume" restarts the countdown and the button label changes back to "Pause".
After starting a timer with Duration "0m 5s", waiting until the timer reaches zero shows the text "Time's up" and the large display shows "0:00:00".
After starting a timer with Duration "0m 30s", clicking the button "Lap" adds a list item containing "Lap 1" and the elapsed time "0:00:10" (assuming 10 seconds have passed).
With two laps recorded, clicking the button "Delete Lap 1" removes the first lap item and the list shows only "Lap 2".
Selecting "5m" in the select labelled "Preset" and clicking the button "Start" sets the large display to "0:05:00".
Reload keeps the timer state: after starting a timer with Duration "1h 0m" and pausing it at "0:59:30", reloading the page still shows the large display "0:59:30" and the button "Resume".
